description:
SCOPE DRAFT (pending PRINCIPAL decisions below before dispatch). The remaining p41 re-homings — shrink the orchestrator skill-load by moving 5 specialist skills off the chief-of-staff/orchestrator menu, per p41 DISPOSITIONS (2026-06-15/16) + the new save-verdict attach-at-write fix (verdict-preservation, from the Arc-62 verdict-loss postmortem).

GROUNDING: p41 dispositions #2 (SessionStart), #3 (modules), #4 (credential-discipline DEFERRED), #5 (KEPT). The 5 skills carry CODE (not markdown-only): check-substrate-updates {apply,check,revert}.sh · check-bw-release check.sh · save-verdict _save_verdict.py+_lib · validate-spec _check_runner.py+_lib+check.sh · inspect-script-output check.sh.

== WORKSTREAM A — SessionStart triggers (check-substrate-updates + check-bw-release) ==
Convert from orchestrator-routed skills → a deterministic SessionStart hook that runs their check scripts. Guardrails (p41 #2): THROTTLE (cache ~once/day per workspace), SURFACE-ON-SIGNAL-ONLY (silent when current; one line on drift/new-release), NON-BLOCKING (never gate boot on a network call). Retire the 2 skills from SKILL_NAMES; the check logic moves to the hook. Existing modules substrate-update-check.md + bw-upgrade.md carry the guidance. Integrates with the check-substrate lifecycle (stoa--sp1).

== WORKSTREAM B — Modules (save-verdict + validate-spec + inspect-script-output) ==
Convert from orchestrator skills → MODULES the dispatched specialist Reads at dispatch (Read .claude/modules/<X>.md), not orchestrator-loaded skills.
- save-verdict: drop the Python SCRIPT for Bash-only body-authoring baked into the module (p41 #3) → retires stoa--j2i/1ne/xyn/7b1.8. ADD the attach-to-bw-at-write fix (the verdict-preservation fix: the verdict-writing seat attaches the verdict to the coordination ticket on beadwork as part of the write, so worktree teardown can't destroy it). Resolve the review-seat no-Write vs mandates-save-verdict tension (stoa--7b1.1) IN THIS ARC.
- validate-spec, inspect-script-output → modules. inspect-script-output relates to existing module mechanical-inspection-split.md.
- VERA/ARGUS/CATO role files: Read the save-verdict module at dispatch instead of invoking the skill.

OUT OF SCOPE: credential-discipline (p41 #4 DEFERRED until the new project version lands). KEPT as orchestrator skills (p41 #5): handoff-author, workflow-composer, team-launcher, interactive-html-preview.

install.sh impact: shrink SKILL_NAMES (−5), add the new modules (+ recompose ownership-partition entries if any are subproject-deployed — FAIL-LOUD Checks A–E, verify via REAL recompose not dry-run per the Arc-61 lesson), add the SessionStart check-trigger hook.
app impact: the gen-data adapter renders every substrate skill as a LIEUTENANT; removing 5 skills DROPS the LIEUTENANT count → update app/src/data/__tests__/generated.test.ts + regen agents.ts.

== OPEN — PRINCIPAL DECISIONS NEEDED BEFORE DISPATCH ==
Q1 (save-verdict Python drop): p41 #3 says drop the script. That LOSES the sha256 round-trip + shape-validation enforcement the Python did. Confirm the trade (slim-core module over tool-enforced verification)? The attach-at-write fix rides the new module either way.
Q2 (validate-spec + inspect-script-output carry code too): p41 #3 says "→ modules" but (unlike save-verdict) does NOT say "drop the script." Do their scripts stay callable (module = instruction wrapper over the existing script) or get dropped to Bash-only like save-verdict?
Q3 (one arc or split): A (SessionStart) + B (modules) are independent; combined this is a big, higher-risk arc (install.sh + a new hook + app + 3 CAPTAIN role files + save-verdict rewrite). RECOMMEND SPLIT: Arc-A (SessionStart, small/self-contained) then Arc-B (modules + save-verdict + no-Write tension + app).
Q4 (fold stoa--92e?): the gauntlet-setup substrate-port (stoa--92e) also edits install.sh + SKILL_NAMES. Consolidate its install.sh work with Workstream A, or keep separate?
Q5 (vehicle): ticket-centric (like the HAMILTON arc) or a committed directive (like CHIRON)? Given the size, RECOMMEND committed directive.
title: [EPIC] Skills-housekeeping — re-home 5 specialist skills (SessionStart triggers + modules) + save-verdict attach-at-write
